harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#597; borg-reborn-rs #845). One build, three arms,
the same 18 classes-18 starts at 300,000 engine turns (suite classes-18-300k), 54 games, evidence retained for all; stalls
and failures retained. The named race 9 / class 7 Ranger seed 1318064166 at 530,000 turns (an X11-startup seed, which a
headless birth does not establish) is a separate diagnostic that is not run here (Rangers are set aside by the owner).
Gate: one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; no config_error; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or
borg_stopped; stalls, timeouts and crashes kept apart; frozen-turn bursts classified; usable town-plan, inventory and
resolved-settings receipts for every cell.
Report per tier (the healing potions Cure Light, Serious and Critical Wounds): actual shops and offers, known or unknown
stock, unit price, spendable gold, CL and max HP, pack and Home counts, purchases and spend, and what the quaff bonus
displaced (Phase Door, food, light, Recall); paired deaths, CL and maximum DL; early healing and escape supplies kept.
Descriptive (RULES 14).
